name: WooCommerce
label: WooCommerce REST wc/v3 — customers, orders, products
description: Merchant WooCommerce Admin REST /wp-json/wc/v3 over HTTPS Basic (consumer_key:consumer_secret). store_host is hostname only. trigger is ingress. HTTPS required. Never log keys or order PII.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: customer_create | customer_get | customer_list | customer_update | customer_delete | order_create | order_get | order_list | order_update | order_delete | product_create | product_get | product_list | product_update | product_delete | trigger. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Resource id for get/update/delete path {id} when that operation needs it.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Customer email. Required on customer_create; used on customer_update. PII — do not log. Example: john.doe@example.com.

schema.label: first_name
schema.description: Customer first name. customer_create/update. Example: John.

schema.label: last_name
schema.description: Customer last name. customer_create/update. Example: Doe.

schema.label: username
schema.description: WP username. customer_create (cannot change later). Example: john.doe.

schema.label: billing
schema.description: Billing address object {first_name,last_name,company,address_1,address_2,city,state,postcode,country,email,phone}. customer_create/update and order_create/update.

schema.label: shipping
schema.description: Shipping address object {first_name,last_name,company,address_1,address_2,city,state,postcode,country}. customer_create/update and order_create/update.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page` for operations: customer_list, order_list, product_list.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `per_page` for operations: customer_list, order_list, product_list.

schema.label: search
schema.description: Query-string parameter `search` for operations: customer_list, product_list.

schema.label: force
schema.description: Query-string parameter `force` for operations: customer_delete, order_delete, product_delete.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Order or product status. Orders: pending | processing | on-hold | completed | cancelled | refunded | failed | trash. Products: draft | pending | private | publish. Used on order_create/update, product_create/update, and order_list query.

schema.label: password
schema.description: Customer password for customer_create/update. Write-only. Never log. Example: a generated secret.

schema.label: currency
schema.description: ISO 4217 currency for order_create/update. Example: USD.

schema.label: customer_id
schema.description: Existing WP user id for order_create/update. Example: 2.

schema.label: payment_method
schema.description: Payment method id for order_create/update. Example: bacs.

schema.label: payment_method_title
schema.description: Payment method title for order_create/update. Example: Direct Bank Transfer.

schema.label: set_paid
schema.description: order_create/update. true marks the order paid (status processing, stock reduced). Default false.

schema.label: line_items
schema.description: Order line items [{product_id, quantity, variation_id?}]. order_create/update. Example: [{"product_id":93,"quantity":2}]. https://developer.woocommerce.com/docs/apis/rest-api/v3/orders

schema.label: shipping_lines
schema.description: Order shipping lines [{method_id, method_title, total}]. order_create/update. Example: [{"method_id":"flat_rate","method_title":"Flat Rate","total":"10.00"}].

schema.label: fee_lines
schema.description: Order fee lines. order_create/update. Example: [{"name":"Fee","total":"5.00"}].

schema.label: coupon_lines
schema.description: Order coupon lines [{code}]. order_create/update. Example: [{"code":"SAVE10"}].

schema.label: customer_note
schema.description: Note from the customer. order_create/update.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Product name. product_create/update. Example: Premium Hoodie.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Product type. EXACT: simple | grouped | external | variable. product_create/update. Default simple.

schema.label: regular_price
schema.description: Product regular price as a decimal string. product_create/update. Example: 29.99.

schema.label: sale_price
schema.description: Product sale price as a decimal string. product_create/update.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Product long description (HTML allowed). product_create/update.

schema.label: short_description
schema.description: Product short description. product_create/update.

schema.label: sku
schema.description: Product SKU. product_create/update. Example: HOODIE-1.

schema.label: manage_stock
schema.description: product_create/update. true to track stock_quantity.

schema.label: stock_quantity
schema.description: Stock count when manage_stock is true. product_create/update. Example: 12.

schema.label: stock_status
schema.description: EXACT: instock | outofstock | onbackorder. product_create/update.

schema.label: categories
schema.description: Product categories [{id}]. product_create/update. Example: [{"id":9}].

schema.label: images
schema.description: Product images [{src}]. product_create/update. Example: [{"src":"https://example.com/a.jpg"}].

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: customer_create | customer_get | customer_list | customer_update | customer_delete | order_create | order_get | order_list | order_update | order_delete | product_create | product_get | product_list | product_update | product_delete | trigger. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Consumer Secret
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type basic. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
